sentences: Routine vibration monitoring of reactor coolant pump B identified a step change in bearing housing acceleration levels during the third week of the operating cycle.
Further analysis of the vibration spectrum revealed subsynchronous frequency components consistent with oil whirl instability in the journal bearing.

The instability was attributed to a reduction in lubricating oil viscosity caused by elevated lube oil temperature, which itself resulted from partial blockage of the lube oil cooler tubes by biological fouling.

As the oil whirl progressed unchecked over subsequent days, the radial clearance between the journal and bearing shell was gradually eroded, ultimately generating metal-to-metal contact and scoring the bearing surfaces.
The damage necessitated an unplanned outage of twelve days to replace the bearing assembly and flush the lube oil system.

sentences: During a scheduled surveillance test of the emergency diesel generator, the unit failed to reach rated speed within the required ten-second start time.
The slow start was caused by an accumulation of carbonaceous deposits on the fuel injector nozzle tips, which restricted fuel flow and produced an uneven fuel spray pattern.
The deposit build-up was linked to prolonged operation on a batch of fuel oil with higher-than-specified aromatic content, which had not been detected during the incoming fuel oil quality sampling.
As a direct consequence, the diesel generator was declared inoperable and a compensatory action was initiated to place the alternate train in a higher state of readiness.

A root cause evaluation concluded that the fuel oil procurement specification did not adequately address aromatic content limits, creating a programmatic vulnerability that had persisted for multiple refuelling cycles.

sentences: Operators noted a gradual downward trend in reactor coolant system inventory over a period of three weeks, with daily unidentified leakage estimates increasing from 0.2 to 1.1 litres per minute.
An augmented leak search was initiated and eventually identified a pinhole perforation on the underside of a small-bore instrument root valve body in the pressuriser instrumentation rack.

Metallurgical examination showed that the perforation had been caused by localised crevice corrosion beneath a pipe clamp whose protective paint coating had blistered and delaminated, trapping moisture against the valve body.
The corrosion had progressed undetected because the valve was located behind a fixed shield panel, preventing routine visual inspection during operational walkdowns.
The event was categorised as a primary pressure boundary leakage event and reported to the regulatory authority within the required four-hour notification window.

sentences: Control room staff received a high-temperature alarm on the safety-related switchgear room ventilation system at 14:23 during normal plant operation.
Investigation revealed that the air handling unit serving the switchgear room had tripped on motor overload protection, leaving the room without forced cooling.

The motor overload had been caused by a seized bearing in the supply fan, which had developed after the bearing grease dried out due to the omission of the bearing from the preventive maintenance lubrication schedule.

Without active ventilation, the switchgear room ambient temperature rose from 24 °C to 41 °C over approximately ninety minutes, exceeding the equipment qualification temperature limit for several Class 1E relay panels.
The elevated temperature caused thermal expansion of the relay contact assemblies, resulting in two spurious actuations of the diesel generator start logic during the event.

The switchgear room was restored to its normal temperature envelope after portable cooling units were deployed, but the relay panels were placed in a degraded condition pending engineering evaluation.

sentences: An operator conducting a local area walkdown in the auxiliary feedwater pump room detected an unusual burning smell near the pump motor terminal box.
On opening the terminal box cover, the operator observed discolouration and carbonisation of the terminal block insulation on phase B, consistent with sustained arcing.

Subsequent investigation determined that a loose phase B terminal lug had developed over time due to differential thermal expansion between the copper conductor and the aluminium terminal block material, generating micro-arcing under load.
The micro-arcing had elevated the local temperature sufficiently to degrade the adjacent insulation on phases A and C as well, placing two additional terminals at risk of a similar failure.

Given the safety significance of the auxiliary feedwater system, the pump was immediately declared inoperable and an expedited repair was authorised to replace the terminal block assembly and re-terminate all phase connections with anti-oxidant compound.

sentences: Following a reactor trip from full power, post-trip review identified that the trip had been initiated by a high neutron flux signal on the wide-range nuclear instrumentation channel.
The channel had produced a falsely elevated reading because a grounding fault on the instrumentation cable shield had introduced a common-mode noise voltage into the detector preamplifier circuit.

The grounding fault was traced to a cable tray modification carried out during the previous outage in which the installer had inadvertently omitted the required shield drain wire termination at the instrumentation cabinet.

The missing termination left the cable shield floating at an intermediate potential, making the detector circuit susceptible to picking up electromagnetic interference from adjacent power cables routed in the same tray.
The event was classified as a human performance issue related to inadequate work package documentation that had failed to specify the shield termination requirement explicitly.

sentences: The work order documents a fuel oil transfer failure that prevented the day tank for emergency diesel generator 2B from being replenished during a surveillance run.
The transfer pump had failed to start because its motor contactor coil had burned out, an event attributed to a sustained overvoltage condition on the 120 VAC control power bus.

Investigation into the overvoltage determined that a voltage regulator tap changer on the unit auxiliary transformer had been left in an incorrect position following transformer maintenance carried out three days earlier.

The incorrect tap position raised the bus voltage from the nominal 120 VAC to approximately 138 VAC, which exceeded the design rating of the contactor coil and caused progressive insulation breakdown.

As a corrective measure, the tap changer was returned to its correct position, the contactor coil was replaced, and a post-maintenance test confirmed normal transfer pump operation and diesel generator day tank replenishment.

sentences: An unplanned reduction in primary coolant flow was observed on loop 3 instrumentation during mid-cycle operation, with the loop flow indication dropping from 100% to approximately 94% of rated flow.

Detailed engineering review attributed the flow reduction to partial closure of the reactor coolant pump discharge isolation valve caused by a failed valve position indicator that had provided a false full-open signal to the control room.

The false signal had persisted for an estimated eleven weeks without detection because the cross-channel comparison alarm for loop 3 flow had been suppressed following a nuisance alarm investigation that was never properly closed out.
The combination of reduced loop flow and the suppressed alarm created a condition in which operators lacked the information needed to identify and correct the valve misalignment in a timely manner.
The event was entered into the corrective action programme as an operability determination and prompted a plant-wide review of all suppressed alarms to identify similar latent vulnerabilities.

sentences: The shift supervisor initiated this work order after portable survey instrumentation detected elevated dose rates of approximately 4 mSv/h in the normally low-dose valve gallery adjacent to the residual heat removal system.
A source investigation identified a buildup of activated corrosion products on the inner surface of an elbow fitting downstream of the residual heat removal heat exchanger outlet.

The deposit accumulation was attributed to a change in system flow velocity profile caused by an internal weld repair performed during the previous outage, which created a low-velocity wake region downstream of the repair site that promoted particle settling.

The settled crud layer had become self-shielding over several months of neutron activation in the vicinity of the reactor, concentrating Co-60 and Co-58 isotopes and building up a contact dose rate that was fifteen times higher than the pre-repair baseline.

Decontamination by high-pressure water jetting was performed to reduce dose rates prior to planned maintenance activities in the gallery, with the resultant effluent processed through the liquid radwaste system.

sentences: A condition report was initiated following the discovery that the train A safety injection accumulator nitrogen cover gas pressure had fallen below its technical specification minimum of 4.05 MPa.
The pressure reduction was traced to a slow leak from a defective needle valve packing on the accumulator nitrogen supply header.

The leak had existed for an indeterminate period because no continuous monitoring system was installed on the accumulator cover gas pressure, with only periodic manual readings taken during monthly surveillance rounds.

By the time the low-pressure condition was identified during the routine surveillance, the accumulator boron solution inventory had partially discharged into the reactor coolant system through the accumulator check valve, raising primary coolant boron concentration above the expected value for the current cycle burnup.

A prompt operability determination was completed, confirming that sufficient accumulator inventory remained to perform the design safety injection function, and a work order was issued to replace the defective needle valve packing.

sentences: During the in-service inspection campaign, eddy current testing of the steam generator A primary side tubes identified indications in seventeen tubes in the upper support plate region.
Analysis of the indication signals indicated outer diameter stress corrosion cracking, with crack depths ranging from 45% to 92% of the tube wall thickness.

The cracking was attributed to a combination of high residual tensile stresses at the tube-to-support plate contact points and the presence of concentrated alkaline deposits in the crevice between the tube outer diameter and the support plate broached hole.

The alkaline deposits had formed over multiple fuel cycles as a result of hideout of sodium hydroxide from the bulk secondary water chemistry during transient boiling events, which concentrated impurities in the crevice geometry.

Tubes with crack depths exceeding 40% of the nominal wall thickness were preventively plugged in accordance with the steam generator tube integrity assessment programme, reducing the active tube complement by three percent but preserving the required heat transfer area within the design margin.

sentences: This condition report captures a loss of redundancy event affecting the train B emergency core cooling system following the discovery of a failed open fuse in the motor protection circuit of the high-pressure safety injection pump.

The failed fuse had caused the pump motor protection relay to de-energise, placing the pump in a non-startable condition without triggering a control room annunciator because the annunciator logic required both train A and train B signals to be in alarm simultaneously.
The single-train loss of safety function had existed undetected for an estimated seventeen days, spanning a period during which plant technical specifications required both trains to be available.

The failure to detect the condition was compounded by an error in the last monthly surveillance procedure execution, where the test step verifying individual pump start capability had been signed off without the pump actually being started due to a miscommunication between the test coordinator and the field operator.

Immediate corrective actions included replacement of the fuse, verification of pump operability by successful start test, and entry into the corrective action programme to address both the physical failure and the surveillance procedure human performance issue.

sentences: Maintenance personnel performing a quarterly inspection of the diesel generator building noted that the floor drain sump pump had failed, allowing approximately 80 cm of water to accumulate on the lower level floor.
The water had entered through roof penetrations that had been left unsealed following antenna cable routing work performed by a contractor the previous month.
The standing water had submerged the lower cable conduit entries to the diesel generator control panel, and water wicking through the conduit seals had reached the interior of the panel.
Moisture inside the panel had caused corrosion of several relay terminals and partial tracking across a printed circuit board in the fuel rack governor controller, degrading speed governor response.

As a result of the governor degradation, the diesel generator exhibited erratic frequency behaviour during the subsequent surveillance start test, failing to maintain frequency within the required ±2 Hz band and necessitating a repeat test after the governor module was replaced.

sentences: Post-maintenance testing of the turbine-driven auxiliary feedwater pump following a planned outage revealed that the pump governor could not maintain steam admission flow at the required rate, causing pump speed to be unstable.

Disassembly of the governor mechanism showed that the fly-weight pivot pins had seized due to corrosion products that had accumulated in the pin bores, preventing the fly-weights from moving freely in response to speed changes.
The corrosion was caused by the introduction of condensate into the governor housing through a cracked steam chest drain line that had not been identified during the pre-maintenance inspection.

Because the governor was unable to modulate steam flow correctly, the pump could not achieve or sustain the minimum required flow rate to the steam generators during the post-maintenance test, which constituted a failure to meet the technical specification surveillance requirement.

The pump was declared inoperable, an operability determination was initiated, and the deficient governor was replaced under an expedited work order to restore the pump to operable status within the allowed outage time.

sentences: Containment radiation monitors indicated a step increase in airborne alpha activity during refuelling operations, prompting an immediate suspension of work and initiation of a source investigation.
Health physics surveys located an elevated alpha smear reading on the refuelling floor in the vicinity of the reactor head storage stand, suggesting that loose contamination had been released.

Subsequent investigation revealed that the seal plug from one of the control rod drive mechanism housings had been inadvertently displaced during head lift, and a small quantity of primary coolant had drained onto the refuelling floor and dried, leaving a residue of boric acid crystals and activated particulate.

The alpha activity in the smear samples was attributed to the presence of activated corrosion product particles containing trace quantities of Pu-239 that had accumulated on internal reactor surfaces over the plant lifetime and been mobilised by the coolant drainage event.

The area was cordoned off, the contamination was removed by wet wiping and HEPA vacuuming, and the seal plug was reinstalled and verified leak-tight before refuelling operations were allowed to resume.

sentences: The condition report was initiated after a loss of coolant flow to two reactor building cooling units was identified during a shift walkdown.

Both cooling units shared a common supply header from the component cooling water system, and investigation showed that the header isolation valve had closed to approximately 15% open due to a failed actuator spring return mechanism.

The actuator spring had fractured because it had been operating beyond its design fatigue life; the maintenance history review revealed that the spring had never been replaced since original plant commissioning thirty-two years earlier, despite the manufacturer's recommended replacement interval of fifteen years.

The loss of reactor building cooling had allowed the ambient temperature in the reactor building to rise by 8 °C over the preceding six-hour period, which had elevated the temperature of several safety-related cable trays routed near the cooling unit discharge grilles.

An operability assessment confirmed that the elevated cable temperatures remained within the qualified environmental envelope, but a conservative decision was taken to reduce reactor power by 20% to lower decay heat and reduce the thermal burden on the building cooling system while the actuator was being repaired.

sentences: A work order was generated following the failure of the boric acid batching system to deliver the correct boron concentration to the primary makeup water system during a scheduled boration evolution.

The batching system delivered a solution with boron concentration approximately 12% below the target value, which caused the primary coolant boron concentration to remain below the required concentration for the given core burnup.

Root cause analysis determined that the solid boric acid feed hopper had developed a bridging blockage just above the screw conveyor inlet, preventing the full quantity of boric acid crystals from reaching the mixing tank.

The bridging had formed because the boric acid crystals had absorbed atmospheric moisture during storage, partially dissolving and recrystallising at the hopper wall contact points to form a solid arch that supported the bulk material above it.

As a corrective measure, the hopper was cleared mechanically, the boric acid inventory was replaced with a fresh dry batch, and a nitrogen purge system was installed on the hopper to prevent future moisture ingress.

sentences: During a routine shift tour, the auxiliary operator reported that the floor of the new fuel storage vault was wet, with water visible pooling around the base of several new fuel assembly storage racks.
The source of the water was traced to a hairline crack in an overhead fire protection deluge system header that ran across the vault ceiling.

The crack had formed at a threaded pipe joint as a result of excessive torque applied during a hydrostatic pressure test carried out three months earlier, which had overstressed the pipe thread and initiated a fatigue crack that propagated under the cyclic pressure fluctuations of the fire protection system.

Although the quantity of water that had entered the vault was small, the presence of uncontrolled water in the new fuel storage area constituted a deviation from the fire hazard analysis assumptions and required a formal operability review of the dry storage configuration.

The deluge header section was isolated and replaced, the vault floor was dried and surveyed for any signs of fuel assembly moisture intrusion, and the hydrostatic test procedure was revised to specify torque limits for all threaded connections.

sentences: Operators observed an unexpected rise in the containment sump level at a rate inconsistent with normal identified leakage, and initiated a leak search in accordance with the abnormal operating procedure.

The leak was localised to the mechanical seal of the residual heat removal pump following a maintenance activity during which the pump had been run dry for approximately forty seconds while the suction valve was being opened.

The dry run had generated sufficient frictional heat at the seal faces to cause thermal distortion of the rotating seal ring, cracking the hard-face coating and creating micro-channels through which primary coolant could bypass the seal.

The damaged seal initially produced a small identified leak of 0.8 litres per hour, but the leak rate increased to 3.2 litres per hour over the following seventy-two hours as the crack propagated further under operating stresses and thermal cycling.

The pump was isolated and removed from service, the mechanical seal assembly was replaced, and the operating procedure was revised to require verification of suction valve full-open status before any pump start following maintenance.

sentences: A loss of the normal offsite power supply occurred at 03:47 when a 400 kV transmission line fault caused the plant to island from the grid.
All four emergency diesel generators started automatically as designed, but diesel generator 3A failed to load within the required ten seconds because its output breaker failed to close.

A compensatory measure was immediately established requiring additional operator rounds in the electrical switchgear area, and an expedited repair of the closing coil was completed within four hours, restoring both emergency buses to their normal independent power sources.

sentences: The turbine building crane was found to be inoperable during pre-lift checks for a planned steam generator manway cover lift, delaying the outage critical path by approximately eighteen hours.
Inspection of the crane electrical system revealed that the main hoist motor contactor had welded closed due to an arc flash event that had occurred during a previous lift operation.

The arc flash had been initiated by a phase-to-earth fault inside the contactor enclosure, attributed to the ingress of metallic swarf from nearby grinding work that had not been adequately barriered from the crane electrical panel.

The welded contactor prevented the hoist motor from de-energising at the end of the previous lift, causing the motor to run continuously until its thermal protection tripped it, by which time the contactor contacts had fused permanently.

A replacement contactor was sourced and fitted under an expedited procurement, the crane was function tested over its full range of motion, and a formal exclusion zone policy was established to prevent contamination of electrical panels during future grinding activities in the turbine building.

sentences: A significant condition adverse to quality was identified when post-maintenance testing of the train B emergency core cooling injection line check valves revealed that two of the three valves failed to open fully under the design differential pressure.

Subsequent disassembly confirmed that the valve discs had seized against their seat rings due to corrosion bonding that had developed during a prolonged system layup period following the previous outage.

Detailed material analysis showed that the corrosion had been accelerated by a deviation in the layup water chemistry, where the hydrazine concentration had been maintained below the minimum specified value for oxygen scavenging, allowing dissolved oxygen to remain in the stagnant system water and attack the valve seat contact surfaces.

The failure of the check valves to open would have significantly impaired emergency core cooling flow delivery to the reactor in the event of a large-break loss-of-coolant accident, representing a potential challenge to core cooling adequacy.

All check valves in both trains of the emergency core cooling system were removed and inspected, corroded components were replaced, and the layup chemistry control procedure was revised with enhanced monitoring requirements and mandatory verification sign-offs at each chemistry sampling interval.

sentences: This work order was raised following an operator report of a high-pitched whistling noise emanating from the area of the pressuriser safety valve cubicle during normal operation at 100% reactor power.

A walkdown confirmed that the noise was originating from the pressuriser safety valve 1A, and an acoustic emission survey indicated that the valve was not fully seated, resulting in a measurable steam flow through the valve into the pressuriser relief tank.

Engineering analysis concluded that the valve had lifted slightly off its seat due to abnormal backpressure from the pressuriser relief tank, caused by a partial blockage of the relief tank vent line by a bird nest that had entered through the vent stack termination.

The elevated backpressure had reduced the effective blowdown margin of the safety valve, causing it to chatter at operating pressure and allowing small quantities of steam to bypass the seat with each pressure pulsation.

The relief tank vent line was cleared, the safety valve was removed and bench-tested to confirm proper set pressure and leak-tightness, and a bird screen was fitted to the vent stack termination to prevent recurrence.

sentences: An unplanned reactor shutdown was performed after the shift supervisor determined that the reactor coolant pump seal leakoff flow on pump 2B had increased beyond the allowable band and was continuing to rise.
The elevated leakoff flow indicated that the No. 1 seal on the pump had degraded and was approaching the leakoff rate that would signal imminent No. 1 seal failure.

Post-shutdown inspection revealed that the seal had been damaged by a brief dry-run condition caused by an inadvertent closure of the controlled leakoff return isolation valve during an unrelated valve lineup verification activity three weeks before the shutdown.

The dry run had scored the seal face and introduced radial cracks in the carbon primary ring, which gradually widened over subsequent weeks of operation as the damaged face lapped unevenly under normal seal loading.

The event demonstrated a latent vulnerability in the seal monitoring programme, in that the initial increase in leakoff flow following the dry-run event had not been trended or investigated, delaying recognition of the degrading seal condition until it had progressed to the point of requiring a shutdown.

sentences: Radiation protection technicians identified an unexpected dose rate of 18 mSv/h on contact with a section of the primary sampling system piping in the chemistry laboratory, triggering an immediate radiological area re-survey and a temporary access restriction.

The elevated dose rate was attributed to the accumulation of a thick layer of activated corrosion products on the inner pipe wall, consistent with a sudden release of crud from reactor internals during a recent power manoeuvre.

Analysis of the deposit composition found elevated concentrations of Co-60, Mn-54, and Zn-65, indicating that the corrosion products had originated from activation of cobalt- and manganese-bearing alloys used in various primary circuit components.

The crud release was linked to a rapid power ramp that had induced changes in coolant chemistry and temperature that disturbed the equilibrium of the corrosion product layer on the fuel cladding surface, causing a fraction of the layer to detach and migrate to downstream surfaces.

Long-term corrective actions included a review of the power ramp rate limits in the fuel management strategy, enhanced chemistry monitoring during future power manoeuvres, and a scheduled decontamination of the primary sampling system piping at the next refuelling outage.

sentences: The condition report documents an event in which the nuclear island chilled water system lost cooling capacity during a summer heat wave, causing inlet air temperatures to several safety-related instrumentation and control rooms to rise above their design basis values.

Investigation showed that the chilled water system had lost capacity because the chiller compressor had tripped on high discharge pressure, itself caused by condenser fouling that had reduced condenser heat rejection efficiency.

The condenser fouling was the result of inadequate cleaning frequency; the maintenance schedule had been revised during a cost reduction initiative the previous year to extend the inter-cleaning interval from six months to eighteen months without a supporting engineering evaluation.

As the I&C room temperatures rose, several temperature-sensitive electronic modules in the reactor protection system began exhibiting marginal behaviour, including two instances of spurious trip logic channel actuations that were reset by operators under procedure.

A conservative decision was made to initiate a controlled shutdown to cold shutdown conditions until the chilled water system was restored to full capacity and all I&C equipment had been inspected and verified within their environmental qualification limits.

sentences: A work order was generated after the in-service inspection team reported that ultrasonic thickness measurements on the carbon steel pipe elbows of the condensate system had revealed wall thinning of up to 43% of the nominal wall thickness at the extrados of several elbows.

The thinning was consistent with flow-accelerated corrosion, a mechanism driven by the dissolution of the protective oxide layer on the pipe inner surface by the flowing fluid, the rate of which is strongly influenced by fluid pH, temperature, flow velocity, and pipe geometry.

Subsequent chemistry record review identified that the condensate system pH had been operating at the lower end of the control range for an extended period, creating more aggressive conditions for oxide dissolution than would have existed at the centre of the control range.

The combination of low pH, high local flow velocities at the elbow extrados, and elevated operating temperature had resulted in corrosion rates approximately three times higher than the design basis assumption used in the original fitness-for-service assessment.

Affected elbows with remaining wall thickness below the fitness-for-service minimum were replaced, the remaining elbows were re-baselined with new thickness measurement reference points, and the condensate pH control band was tightened to reduce future corrosion rates.

sentences: A loss of position indication on the main feedwater regulating valve for steam generator 2 was identified during the morning shift, leaving the control room without feedback on valve position during an active power ascension.
The position transmitter had failed because water had entered the transmitter housing through a degraded conduit fitting, short-circuiting the internal signal conditioning electronics.

The water ingress had been occurring intermittently for several weeks but had gone undetected because the transmitter failure mode was intermittent, producing occasional valid readings that masked the underlying degradation from routine surveillance checks.

Without reliable valve position feedback, the automatic feedwater control system reverted to a fixed-demand mode and was unable to compensate for a steam generator level perturbation that arose during a grid frequency transient, causing steam generator 2 level to deviate from its setpoint by more than the allowable band.

The shift supervisor manually controlled feedwater flow using local indication until the transmitter was replaced and calibrated, at which point automatic control was restored and steam generator level was recovered to within the normal operating range.
